apps.name: V380 Lite
apps.description: V380 Lite is a video surveillance service app for android phones. You can monitor your house, apartment, villa, shop, factory, office, or other places using a phone or tablet. This platform connects to the surveillance system through a wireless network, so that you can view the situation at home, or your office, from the app. V380 Lite can play the live feed from the cameras in real-time. V380 Lite, all in all, features remote monitoring via the app itself, a voice intercom, equipment sharing, motion tracking - a feature that tracks any sort of movement within the premises you are surveying, and mobile monitoring and alarm.
